description: List bachelor's-degree majors (19 broad categories and/or 115 CIP subfields) with lifetime-ROI stats: median/mean lifetime ROI (USD), % of programs that never break even, median break-even age, and AI-exposure band. Returns compact rows sorted by the chosen field. Use the returned slug with get_major for full detail.

kind.description: Filter to broad categories (19), CIP subfields (115), or all 134.

parent.description: Only subfields of this category slug, e.g. 'engineering'.

sort_by.description: Sort field. ROI sorts are descending; name ascending.

name: list_majors
title: List majors by lifetime ROI
